coverage_notes:
[banks-major] 483 entries: 177 'detailed' (support/how-to links researched) and 306 'roster' (counts after the third review pass, 2026-09-30). Completeness checked against the FDIC BankFind institutions API (ACTIVE=1, top 450 by total deposits, REPDTE 2026-06-30; rosters/banks_fdic.csv and rosters/_raw/banks_major/fdic_top450.json): every one of those charters is present. Detailed coverage: all consumer-facing banks in the FDIC top 100 by deposits are detailed except wealth/custody/commercial or captive charters where consumers do not pay bills (BNY, State Street, Morgan Stanley, Northern Trust, UBS, Deutsche, CIBC, Western Alliance, Texas Capital, TriState, Raymond James, Stifel, Ameriprise, Schwab Premier/Trust, TD Bank USA card charter, Sallie Mae - covered in the student-loan category, Customers Bank, Bank of China) plus TowneBank, Beacon Bank & Trust and FirstBank Puerto Rico, which remain roster tier because their sites were bot-blocked or JS-only in this session. Online banks/fintechs covered: Ally, Capital One 360 (incl. Discover), Marcus, SoFi, Varo, Chime, Happen Bank (formerly LendingClub), Axos, Schwab Bank, American Express National Bank, Synchrony, Barclays US, EverBank, CIT (First Citizens). Method: 2026-09-29 session re-verified the earlier run's weak entries (Huntington, USAA, Marcus, Fifth Third, KeyBank, Regions, Zions, SouthState, Arvest, Banc of California) in a real browser session because curl/WebFetch were blocked by Cloudflare/Akamai/Imperva, and upgraded Citi, BMO, Columbia (Umpqua), Pinnacle + Synovus, Flagstar, Eastern, Ameris, Renasant, Provident, NBT, Capitol Federal, First Merchants, First Financial (OH) by hand. About 45 regional/community banks (rank ~100-450) were upgraded by an automated crawl: homepage + help/contact page fetched with curl, linked bill-pay/eStatement/loan-payment pages re-fetched and title-checked (HTTP 200); for those, phone_customer_service lists the first toll-free numbers on the contact page with their on-page context and should be confirmed. Known gaps: many banks publish no public autopay-cancel page (cancellation is inside online banking or by phone) so autopay_cancel is often null; pay-by-phone numbers are sparse; Third Federal, TowneBank, Apple Bank, First Financial (TX, ffin.com), Sunflower, Bankers Trust and Beacon help pages could not be content-confirmed (bot protection); roster-tier entries (ranks ~100-450) mostly carry only website/help/contact data; credit unions (incl. Navy Federal, PenFed) are in credit-unions.json; bank-issued credit cards are also in credit-cards-major.json; mortgage subservicers (Dovenmuehle, etc.) are in mortgage-servicers.json. Banks below the FDIC top ~450 (about 3,800 small community banks) are not listed. REVIEW PASS (2026-09-29, second reviewer): (1) Completeness: re-checked against rosters/banks_fdic.csv (top 400 by deposits). All 400 certs are present and there are no duplicate certs; names that repeat belong to different charters. Added 13 legacy/merged-brand pointer entries so seniors who remember an old name are sent to the bank that now serves them: Citizens First Bank of The Villages FL (now Seacoast; detailed), MidWestOne (Nicolet, conversion Aug 10 2026), HomeStreet (Mechanics), HarborOne (Eastern), Pacific Premier (Columbia), CrossFirst (Busey), Lakeland (Provident), TCF (Huntington), Signature (Flagstar), First Republic (Chase), MUFG Union Bank (U.S. Bank), People's United (M&T) and FirstBank Colorado (PNC; redirect not confirmed). Each redirect was confirmed with curl on this date except FirstBank. Upgraded 8 roster entries to detailed: HSBC Bank USA, FirstBank Puerto Rico, Green Dot (Bonneville), First Commonwealth, Tompkins, Tri Counties, Stock Yards and Hanmi. Webster was also filled in. Origin, Central Pacific, American Savings Bank (HI) and Nicolet stay roster but gained contact, loan-payment and phone data. (2) Accuracy: all 1,012 distinct URLs on detailed entries were re-fetched with curl and their titles checked. 873 returned 200 with a real title; 137 returned 403 or timed out behind bot protection (Regions, USAA, PNC, KeyBank, Arvest, Huntington, Marcus, BMO, Wells Fargo and others; these were browser-verified by the earlier run and not re-confirmed here). Fixes: Bank of Hawaii's e-statements demo link had become a redirect, so it was replaced with its destination page. UCBI's recurring-payments demo link was replaced with the demos hub it redirects to. Westfield Bank's loan payment center showed 'Temporarily Unavailable', which is now noted. mycardstatement.com (a bank-branded credit-card statement portal) was wrongly used as the deposit statements link for 7 banks; it moved to links.credit_card_statements. A Northwest Bank link sat on the wrong charter and was moved. (3) Filled 58 core link fields, mostly autopay_setup and autopay_cancel, by reusing a bill-pay or autopay page only when its fetched text explicitly describes recurring or automatic payments, or how to cancel or stop them. The quoted evidence is in each entry's notes. Amex gained statements_history and the Financial Relief Program page as payment_assistance. payment_processor is now set on every detailed entry; where no vendor is disclosed it reads 'in-house ... (vendor not named)', and third-party loan portals seen in links (billerweb, ProfitStars SmartPay, Allied PortalPay, paybill.com, LenderPay, MessagePay, SwivelPay, Link2Gov) are named. Added senior programs for FirstBank TN (USA Checking for Seniors, 62+), First Citizens, Zions, Northwest (IA) and Amex. WebSearch was unavailable (session budget used up) and WebFetch hit a session limit partway through, so this pass used curl and sitemaps only. REVIEW PASS 3 (2026-09-30, third reviewer). Completeness: all FDIC top-450 charters remain present with no duplicate certs. Charters that share a name (Northwest Bank PA/IA, First Bank NC/MO/NJ, Five Star Bank NY/CA, and others) now include their HQ city in the name. Added 10 legacy/merged-brand pointer entries after confirming each redirect with curl or a browser: Berkshire Bank, Brookline Bank and Bank Rhode Island (now Beacon Bank & Trust), Heritage Bank of Commerce (now Citizens Business Bank), First National Bank of Long Island (ConnectOne), Luther Burbank Savings (WaFd), William Penn Bank (Mid Penn), Jersey Shore State Bank/Luzerne (Northwest Bank PA), Evans Bank (NBT) and Premier Bank WV/KY (Peoples Bank). Upgrades: 22 roster banks are now detailed. Two were rendered in a real browser because curl was blocked: Apple Bank and Beacon Bank & Trust. The rest were read with curl: Citizens Business Bank, Enterprise Bank & Trust, Nicolet, Dime, Bell, PlainsCapital, Columbia Bank (NJ), Washington Trust Bank, American Savings Bank (HI), S&T, Byline, 1st Source, Central Pacific, Horizon, TrustCo, Old Second, Lake City, Midland States, Mid Penn and Kearny. Mid Penn carries a time-sensitive note: online banking is view-only Oct 26-28, 2026 for a platform upgrade. Oriental, Amalgamated, Centier and Farmers & Merchants (Long Beach) gained contact, payment-portal and senior data but stay roster because they publish no public how-to pages or render them only in JavaScript. Accuracy: 884 distinct link URLs on detailed entries were re-fetched with curl. 772 returned HTTP 200 (734 with a real page title), 80 returned 403 and 31 timed out (bot protection at PNC, KeyBank, BMO, Huntington, Flagstar, Capitol Federal, NBT, Provident, SouthState, Columbia/Umpqua, Ameris, Marcus, Varo, Banc of California and others; these rely on earlier browser checks). No 404s were found. Blank-title 200s were Incapsula/JS challenge pages (Third Federal, 53.com, cit.com). Fixes: Banco Popular's phone had been its TDD line. It now lists the TeleBanco numbers, plus Mi Banco Payments, Direct Payment autopay, English e-Statements and TeleBanco pay-by-phone. Seacoast's FAQ link followed its redirect to /contact-us. Kearny, Old Second and Horizon had loan-portal URLs used as pay_bill; these are now separated. Core links were filled for SoFi (help-center articles for Bill Pay, cancel/edit, statements and loan autopay), FNB, East West, Frost, Bank OZK, BankUnited, UMB, Seacoast and Dollar Bank. autopay_cancel was added for TD (Digital Academy guide), Associated, BOK Financial, EverBank and Hancock Whitney, and reused only where the fetched text explicitly describes cancelling, stopping or deleting scheduled payments. Missing customer-service phones were filled for BOK, Axos, Rockland Trust, Happen and Habib American. Axos and Happen numbers come from schema.org ContactPoint data and should be confirmed. payment_assistance was added for 10 banks and senior_programs for 23; these are mostly elder-fraud and caregiver education pages, plus senior accounts at Stock Yards (50+), Pinnacle Bank NE and Bank of Colorado, and East West Senior Checking (62+ confirmed). Remaining gaps: 17 detailed entries still have at most one of the five core links (Pinnacle/pnfp.com, Valley, Banc of California, Glacier, Axos, City National Bank of Florida, WaFd, Centennial, Mechanics, FirstBank TN, First United, Columbia Bank NJ, Burke & Herbert, Wintrust, CNB Bank, Kearny and the Citizens First legacy entry), because those sites are bot-blocked or JavaScript-only or publish no how-to pages. TowneBank and First Financial (TX, ffin.com) remain roster: Imperva/Cloudflare challenges block both, and the shared browser was contended by other agents this session. autopay_cancel is filled on only 44 of 177 detailed entries, and pay-by-phone on only 23. WebSearch was unavailable (session budget exhausted), so discovery used sitemaps, homepage links, curl and WebFetch. LINK BACKFILL PASS (2026-09-30/10-01; change set in categories/link-backfill-banks.json): on the 177 previously detailed banks, view_bill 133->158 (89%), statements_history 134->159, autopay_cancel 44->91 (51%), payment_assistance 46->58 (33%), senior_programs 68->75; elder-financial-abuse/trusted-contact links now on 58 of 237 detailed entries (new link keys elder_financial_abuse, trusted_contact, plus extras such as borrower_assistance). The 60 largest consumer-facing roster banks by FDIC deposits were upgraded to detailed (237 detailed total), and all 13 roster charters with no FDIC WEBADDR now have a website (mostly foreign-bank branches, Schwab/Morgan Stanley sweep charters and Erebor; several are parent-bank sites, see each entry's notes). autopay_cancel is filled only where fetched text explicitly says how to cancel/stop/delete/edit a scheduled, recurring or bill-pay payment (some are Zelle-scheduled-payment or transfer pages; notes say so). Still missing: many mid-size and community banks publish no public cancel-autopay or hardship page (they say 'call us'); Citi, Valley, Bank OZK, Frost, Banc of California, Pinnacle (pnfp), Prosperity and Fulton help content is JavaScript-rendered or behind logins so those fields stay null; WebSearch was unavailable (session budget exhausted), so discovery used sitemaps, homepage/help-page link expansion, curl, WebFetch and an in-browser same-origin read of public pages for bot-blocked sites (KeyBank, Santander, Popular, Flagstar). REVIEWER PASS (2026-10-01): Every URL in this change set was re-checked (1,118 unique URLs; curl with a browser user agent). 1,020 returned HTTP 200. 66 returned 403 and 30 timed out. These failures are bot-blocking on sites the researcher read in a browser (Huntington, KeyBank, Flagstar, Westamerica, Sunflower, First American, Middlesex, Bankers Trust, FFIN, Broadway, Dollar Bank and others), not dead links. The text of every autopay_cancel and payment_assistance page was checked against the claim in its notes. Fixes made: (1) autopay_cancel set to null for Commerce Bank, Midland States and Five Star Bank (Rochester), because the pages do not explain cancelling. (2) Republic Bank: /help now redirects to the easysupport.republicbank.com knowledge base. help_center_url was updated, and autopay_cancel now points to the KB article on cancelling or editing a scheduled Bill Pay payment. (3) An Independent Bank link pointed at a HubSpot sandbox host and was replaced with the production page. (4) A Farmers & Merchants Bank of Long Beach support link that returned HTTP 500 was set to null. (5) Hardship phone numbers from the fetched pages were added for Happen Bank and Dollar Bank. Caveats were added for the OceanFirst card-controls link and the First Horizon statement-copy link, which requires login. (6) Merger notes were added to the surviving banks: Fifth Third (Comerica), Huntington (Cadence, Veritex, TCF), PNC (FirstBank Colorado), Old National (Bremer) and Atlantic Union (Sandy Spring). (7) Univest Bank and Trust ($7.0B, retail bank in PA/NJ/MD) was upgraded to detailed. Some sites were checked but not upgraded. TowneBank ($18.8B, retail, VA/NC) is behind an Imperva human-verification challenge, which was not bypassed, so it stays roster and is the most important remaining gap. Needham Bank's public pages have no consumer bill-pay or statement help. A spot check of the upgrade list against FDIC deposits found that the researcher's skips over larger roster charters were consistent with their stated rule. Most skipped charters are custody, wealth-sweep or commercial banks (BNY, State Street, Northern Trust, Western Alliance, Texas Capital) or card and captive-finance charters covered by other categories (TD Bank USA, Sallie Mae, Toyota, Comenity, Merrick, BMW). The exceptions are TowneBank, NBH Bank (Community Banks of Colorado / Bank Midwest brands), Oriental Bank and Amalgamated, which are retail banks still at roster tier. Roster completeness: all 400 charters in rosters/banks_fdic.csv are present, and there are no duplicate names or FDIC certs. A local regex check of autopay_cancel pages produced several false positives, such as check stop-payment FAQs. Each one was resolved by reading the page text. United Bank, United Community, Rockland, First Horizon, Shore United, ANB Bank and Fremont do contain cancel or stop guidance, so they were kept. After review: 238 detailed of 483 charters. SECOND REVIEW PASS (2026-10-02): Upgraded NBH Bank (via its Community Banks of Colorado retail site cobnks.com; hillcrestbank.com now redirects to Vista Bank), Oriental Bank (FAQ answers read from the site's own public FAQ JSON endpoint plus the Loss Mitigation page) and Amalgamated Bank to detailed; banks-major.json now has 241 detailed of 483 entries. TowneBank is still behind an Imperva human-verification challenge (curl, WebFetch and the in-app browser), which was not bypassed, so it stays roster; its sitemap lists make-a-payment, loan-payment-services and Senior Partners checking pages that could not be read. Valley Bank: view_bill, autopay_setup, statements_history and paperless filled from the Mortgage Hub and Auto Loan Help pages, read in a browser. Corrections: PNC autopay_cancel pointed at the credit-card payment-options page, which describes setting up recurring payments but not cancelling them; it now points to the Online Bill Pay page ('Cancel or update your payment anytime before it processes'). Fifth Third autopay_cancel pointed at the loan FAQ, whose autopay answer only says to call 800-837-2000; it now points to the Bill Pay page, which mentions modifying or cancelling scheduled payments. Notes were clarified for FNBO (stop a bill payment by phone only) and American Savings Bank (the autopay_cancel link is a Zelle page). Spot checks: links on 35 random detailed change-set entries were curl-checked; all returned 200 except known bot-blocked hosts (Westamerica 403, PNC timeouts), and PNC, Popular and Happen were confirmed with WebFetch. The text of every autopay_cancel page (77) was scanned for cancel/stop/delete wording, and about 20 doubtful ones were read; most describe cancel steps in bill-pay terms or FAQs. Every payment_assistance page (51) was scanned for hardship wording, and 7 pages with no hits were read with WebFetch (M&T, Old National, Community Bank N.A., German American, Hanmi and others); all describe hardship contacts or programs. Still not fixed: Citi, Bank OZK, Frost, Prosperity (no cancel text on its Online Bill Pay or Online Banking FAQ pages, confirmed 2026-10-02), Fulton and Pinnacle (pnfp) remain without autopay_cancel or payment_assistance. Post-review totals for banks-major detailed entries: view_bill 208/241, statements_history 208, autopay_cancel 106, payment_assistance 68, senior_programs 82, payment_processor 184.
